title: SiteLog roadmap
tagline: Work is guided by feature: one feature is finished end to end before the next starts.
intro: Work is guided by feature: one feature is finished end to end before the next starts.
Specs: docs/feature-docs; step-by-step guides: docs/feature-guide, one per feature.

blocks.html:
• Every feature runs the same steps: Domain → fake data → view models → real data → tests.
  • Fakes live only in the Data layer (Packages/DataLayer/Sources/DataLayer/Fakes/). Domain and Presentation never name a fake; AppDependencies picks fake or real, and the dev menu seeds / clears the fakes.
  • The UI skeleton (~30% of Figma, every screen) is done; a feature's view models replace its FakeData use in App/Fakes/FakeData.swift and delete those types. The other ~70% of the UI is F16, last.
  • Step format: FXX.n - [layer] - [est hours] - description.
  • Estimates: dev-hours for one developer new to Swift and SwiftUI, learning included.

blocks.html:
1. One feature at a time, in the order above; a feature is done when its demo runs on a real device and its tests pass.
  2. Each step ends with something runnable, never "half a screen".
  3. Fakes only in Packages/DataLayer/Sources/DataLayer/Fakes/; switching fake → real changes AppDependencies only.
  4. Tests come after a feature is done: once it works end to end, write the tests listed in its guide. No tests while a step is still being built.
  5. Visual work to Figma waits for F16; until then a step changes layout only when a view model needs it.
  6. A step estimated above 8h is split when you start it.
  7. Tick the box in the same commit that finishes the step.
